chatTemplate.character.text: Create a character for this world. Include role, motive, secret, public rumor, and 2-3 links to existing cards if relevant.
chatTemplate.location.text: Create a location for this world. Include atmosphere, what players can learn there, hidden danger, and possible connections.
chatTemplate.faction.text: Create a faction for this world. Include goal, resources, public face, secret agenda, and relationships.
chatTemplate.event.text: Create an event for the timeline. Include cause, result, participants, date/order, and what is still misunderstood.
chatTemplate.quest.text: Create a quest. Always make the quest itself a primary entity tagged quest. Include objective, giver, stages, complication, reward, failure consequence, and related cards.
chatTemplate.map.text: Create a map location or point of interest. Include what is visible, what is hidden, suggested pins, and linked cards.
chatTemplate.randomTable.text: Create a new random table with 6 concise results. Include its name and purpose, plus a label, weight, and secrecy for every row.
chatTemplate.clue.text: Create an investigation clue. Include what players see, what it implies, false interpretation, and which board nodes it should connect.
